name: status-digest
description: The recurring report (D6): three deterministic collectors (git log window, run inventory, test suite) -> a readonly-sourced narrative written to digest.md -> the NUMBER-PROVENANCE gate: every numeral in the prose must appear in a collector's output (gates/numbers_check.py; heals the narrative once) -> evidence-bearing approval over the digest itself. This mechanises 'never quote a cost from memory' for a whole document class: the numbers are mechanical, the prose is judged, and the gate is what joins them. Schedule it weekly.

cmd: rejecting leaves digest.md as a draft; nothing is published
the status digest for the last {args.days} days
